title: Buddy Actions Idea Index
purpose: Make the Actions page the visible backlog-to-evidence map for approved Buddy ideas and repository goals.
rules: Every idea becomes a mission or capability record before implementation.
Every mission links to an owner specialist, benchmark, evidence source and next action.
Failed attempts become lessons and regression tests rather than disappearing.
Unknown and planned are distinct from passing or mastered.
Consequential actions remain permission and approval gated.
The Actions page is a control plane and prospectus, not proof that every integration is already live.
